newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nov Oman trades at Nov Dubai plus 84 cts - traders.
newsitem.headline: Nov Oman trades at Nov Dubai plus 84 cts - traders.

text.p: A 500,000 barrel November Oman cargo was traded between two majors at November Dubai quotes plus 84 cents, traders said on Wednesday.
They said they believed it was the first November Oman cargo sold.
November cargoes for Oman have largely failed to attract buyers because of what traders termed a high official selling price of the crude.
Term lifters of Oman crude have been calling for a sharp cut in the official selling price.
